name: Ore no Koto ga Suki na Ano ko wa, Hentai Mazo Bishoujo Datta ~Kokuhaku Sarete Do S ni Mezame Saserareru Hanashi~
original_name: 俺の事が好きなあの子は、変態マゾ美少女だった ～告白されてドSに目醒めさせられる話～
source:
"[i]Sensei[/i], I like you, please go out with me."

The most beautiful girl in the school, that Makino Saya, from my class?
No way. This must have been some kind of joke or a punishment game.

That was my thought. Until the elegant girl showed her hidden side.

――Only for [i]sensei[/i], I'll show you...... My secret.

White skin, leather and ropes.
Blushing, gasping, she confessed to me. 

"I'm a helpless perverted masochist girl. Hey, [i]sensei[/i]...... with someone like me, what would you like to do?"

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1245398]Getchu[/url]]
